title: Prepare base-only task snapshots and the workspace mask
body:
Second slice of the evaluation harness (decision `.krn/runs/claude/eval-design/decision.md`): `krn eval prepare` builds one Git repository per experiment task that holds only the objects reachable from the task base at depth 1 (no exemplar objects, remotes, tags or reflogs; source untouched), under a root with no `.git`/`.krn` ancestor; `krn eval mask` runs a command in an empty-root mount namespace that sees only its slot at `/w`, read-only system and tool directories, and no network unless asked.
Acceptance: a fixture source with a later exemplar commit and a dangling object yields a snapshot without either; inside the mask the experiment files, a neighbour slot, the source repository and the operator harness home are unreadable while `/w/repo` is writable, TCP fails without `--network`, and a Unix socket binds under `/w/t`.
